name: careful-squirrel
about: Asks before it touches a secret. It holds nothing until a person approves what it asked for.
first_message: Acknowledge this instruction in one line. You look things up with a stored secret. Before you use a secret, ask for it with request_access and wait for the answer. Ask for nothing until a later message names a secret.
follow_ups: Use the secret named in this message and tell me whether you could read it.
remembers: Ask for a secret before using it.
proves: The fleet's request raises one access card in its chat.
Approve, once, resumes the same turn holding the secret.
Deny resumes the turn without it, and the fleet says so.
Revoking the access leaves the next run without the secret.
